directAnswer: You can stop Windows from waking your PC by adjusting the power settings and disabling wake timers. Additionally, check device settings to prevent them from waking the computer.
summary: This guide provides steps to prevent Windows from waking your PC unexpectedly, including power settings adjustments and device configurations.

sections.heading: Adjust Power Settings
sections.body: Navigate to the Power Options in the Control Panel to modify advanced settings that control wake timers and sleep behavior.

sections.heading: Configure Device Settings
sections.body: Check the properties of devices such as your mouse and network adapter to ensure they are not set to wake the computer.

steps.title: Open Power Options
steps.detail: Right-click the Start button, select 'Power Options', then click on 'Additional power settings'.

steps.title: Change Plan Settings
steps.detail: Select 'Change plan settings' next to your selected power plan, then click 'Change advanced power settings'.

steps.title: Disable Wake Timers
steps.detail: In the advanced settings, expand 'Sleep', then 'Allow wake timers', and set it to 'Disable'.

steps.title: Modify Device Properties
steps.detail: Open Device Manager, right-click on devices like your mouse or network adapter, select 'Properties', go to the 'Power Management' tab, and uncheck 'Allow this device to wake the computer'.

faqs.question: What if my PC still wakes up after following these steps?
faqs.answer: Check for scheduled tasks in Task Scheduler that might be set to wake the computer or review any third-party software that may interfere with sleep settings.

faqs.question: Can I stop my keyboard from waking the PC?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can disable the wake feature for your keyboard in Device Manager under the 'Power Management' tab.

faqs.question: Are there any updates that could affect power settings?
faqs.answer: Yes, Windows updates can sometimes reset power settings. It's advisable to review these settings after major updates.

caveats: Some devices may not have the option to disable wake features, depending on manufacturer settings.
